title: Metric-Deformed Heisenberg Algebras and the $q$-Dirac Operator
summary: We introduce a family of metric-deformed Heisenberg algebras $M_1$ and $M_2$, where the commutation relations are expressed directly in terms of the components of a diagonal Lorentzian metric. We show that these algebras unify several known $q$-deformed Heisenberg algebras, including the $q$-$\hbar$ algebra, the new $q$-Heisenberg algebra, and the $q$-generalized Heisenberg algebra, which embed as special cases.
